name: Marese
summary: A Mayfair lingerie house at night: a big spaced logotype centred over an oxblood strip, the campaign edge to edge (two women in the house's lingerie, lamplight on skin, one grade), then new season on models with collection, style, colour and price, tall category doors, close crops as chapter openers, 'Tell us about her' beside its own photograph, and the box with its oxblood ribbon untied. Blossom ground, stone ink, oxblood as the one signature colour used in full blocks; Bellefair very large, Karla for everything else. For lingerie boutiques and women-founded lingerie brands that sell desire.
